column1: # Report numbers and data dates for INSP PDFs whose FILENAME carries neither.
# These were read from each PDF's own front page ("SitRep MVE N° 005", "19 mai
# 2026") and are recorded here because they cannot be recovered from the media
# API listing alone. Checked in so the index is reproducible without
# re-downloading and re-parsing every PDF.
# Note the filename dates are misleading and must NOT be parsed as data dates:
# "SitRep_MVE_RDC_20260512-FDv2.pdf" is SitRep 7 reporting data as of 21 May,
# not 12 May. Likewise "2022vf2" is SitRep 8 and "2024fv1" is SitRep 9 -- those
# digits are not report numbers, and reading them as such would collide with
# the genuine SitReps 22 and 24.
# Also covers reports whose filename carries a number but no parseable date
# (SitReps 10, 11, 21, 38, 59): the filename writes the month as a word
# (`04_JUIN_2026`, `21Jun2026`) or omits the date entirely. Dates below are the
# `date de rapportage` printed on each front page -- the date the figures
# describe, NOT the publication date, which is one day later.
# Verified 2026-08-07 against the PDF front pages.
